hook.name: GUNHook
hook.description: A gamified hook for a GUN/ETH pool that records each swap as a "shot" in a Western-themed game, tracking buy/sell pressure (heat/recoil), advancing a chamber based on tick distance from genesis, and resolving periodic "duels". Swaps via the designated gunRouter can supply hookData with a player address and stance for personalized scorekeeping; swaps without hookData succeed normally.
